title: Hearing Tony Jackson in New Orleans and Chicago
summary: Interviewer asks about hearing Tony Jackson; Carew says he heard him in New Orleans and once in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: I want to ask you, Roy, you said that when you were a young man in New Orleans, you heard Tony down there on at least one occasion. I see, remember you were saying that? Heard Tony Jackson in New Orleans?
Oh yes, I heard, that's where I did hear him, was in New Orleans. The reason I heard him in Chicago on one occasion, that's where the one occasion comes in.
